# Mickey's Mailboxes

> A small shop in Grand Rapids, Michigan, USA selling steel mailboxes and parcel boxes for houses, duplexes and
> shared driveways. Six products, prices in US dollars, shipped by ground ("Original Delivery") to street addresses
> in the lower 48 states. Website: https://emailmickey.com/ . Contact: boxes@emailmickey.com

## Products and prices
- Wall-mount letterbox: $59 (Galvanized steel, 13.5 × 4.5 × 15 in, drop slot 12 × 3 in, key lock)
- Post-mount mailbox: $79 (Curbside steel tunnel, 21 × 8 × 10.5 in, sprung door, red flag)
- Parcel drop box: $189 (Lockable steel, hopper opening 15 × 11 in, 6,480 cu in inside)
- Rocket Pool shared parcel box: $349 (Shared steel box, hopper opening 19 × 14 in, 15,840 cu in, eight keys)
- Mailbox post: $69 (2 in square galvanized post, welded arm, 24 in ground sleeve)
- House number plate: $29 (10 × 4 in steel plate, 3 in stock numerals, up to five digits)

## Sizer rules
1. The two smallest sides of the biggest parcel must clear the box opening.
2. The longest side must fit the longest run inside the box.
3. Interior volume must be at least 2 x parcel volume x busy-day parcels x households; a busy day is a third of a typical week, rounded up.
Boxes: wall-mount letterbox (opening 12 x 3 in, 728 cu in), parcel drop box (15 x 11 in, 6,480 cu in), Rocket Pool shared parcel box (19 x 14 in, 15,840 cu in).

## What the shop does not do
No installation visits. No email or online services. No custom engraving. No shipping outside the lower 48 states.
